home.meta_title: Pulse Flow Ops - The pulse of your rental operations
home.meta_description: Pulse Flow Ops keeps property status, jobs, contacts, and bills in one live pulse for owners, managers, and field teams.
home.og_description: The pulse of your rental operations
home.headline:
Built for rental ops,
not generic task lists.
home.sub: Properties, jobs, contacts, and bills - one shared pulse between you and your team, live on every screen.
home.card_properties_desc: Status, a map pin, notes, and a property photo so staff recognize the place on sight.
home.card_jobs_desc: Appointments with clear work windows, and a read & agreed confirmation from the team.
home.card_contacts_desc: Cleaners, plumbers, and electricians - one tap to call or message on LINE or WhatsApp.
home.card_bills_desc: Submit an expense, owner approves, everyone sees the running total in real time.
home.why_title: Why do you need this app?
home.why_lead: Pick the seat that matches how you run rental properties. Open the guide that fits your role.
home.audience_owner_desc: See occupancy, urgent work, and spend without calling for a status update.
home.audience_manager_desc: Day-to-day ops, reports for owners, and handoffs in one place.
home.audience_staff_title: Are you staff working on a few properties?
home.audience_staff_desc: Jobs, Read and agreed, and assigned properties on your phone.
home.plan_title: Personal is free. Company unlocks the team.
home.plan_lead: Solo ops stay free. A company plan adds invites, assigned properties, chat, job booking, and team reputation.
home.close_title: Put a pulse on every rental day.
home.close_lead: Open the app, invite your team, and run the next turnover from one place.

staff.og_title: Pulse Flow Ops for field staff
staff.og_description: Assigned jobs, Read & agreed, personal checklist, and expense receipts on your phone.
staff.headline: Your jobs. Confirm once. Finish the day.
staff.sub: See assigned jobs, tap Read & agreed, keep a personal checklist, submit receipts, and manage only the properties that are yours to run.
staff.extra: Accept jobs with Read & Agreed, mark work done, submit receipts, and stay on the same pulse as owners and managers - in the language you actually work in.
staff.hero_alt: Tasks list showing assigned jobs with times and properties
